project_type: Next.js 16 App Router (Turbopack) + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS 3 + shadcn/ui (Radix primitives) + Mongoose/MongoDB + Auth.js (Credentials). Owner-only PG (paying guest) management panel.
build_system: npm + Next.js 16.4.3 (Turbopack). Build: `npm run build` (next build). Dev: `npm run dev`. Seed: `npm run seed` (tsx). Path alias `@/*` -> repo root (see tsconfig.json paths). Windows workspace — ALWAYS use forward slashes in import paths (e.g. `@/components/ui/button`).
test_framework: None configured. There is no vitest/jest. The build (`npm run build`, which type-checks) is the only verification gate. `npm run lint` exists (eslint) but the task gate is the build.
verification_instructions: Run `npm run build` from the repo root c:/Users/Adarsh/Desktop/agency/demo-demand/PG. It must finish with 0 TypeScript/compile errors. There are no unit tests. After build passes, optionally `npm run dev` and visually confirm routes, but the mandatory gate is a clean build.
snapshot_or_generated_files: next-env.d.ts and .next/ are generated by the build and are gitignored; do not hand-edit. No codegen step needed.
environment_constraints: Windows host, bash shell. Dev server may already be running on :3000 — do NOT rely on it for verification; use `npm run build`. Mongo connection string lives in .env.local (do not echo secrets). Do NOT change routing, route structure, link hrefs, financial business logic under lib/services/*, or any Mongoose model in models/. The AGENTS.md 'nextjs-agent-rules' block is auto-managed by next dev — leave it; this task is styling-only so node_modules/next/dist/docs/ does NOT need to be read.
contribution_requirements: Styling + form UI/UX only. Keep all link hrefs identical. Keep all server actions / services / validators / models unchanged. Money stays integer rupees; dates stay UTC/IST conventions (unchanged, not touched here). Every file in this task is touched by exactly one FEAT — do not re-edit a file a later FEAT owns.
key_patterns: shadcn/ui primitives live in components/ui/* and use cva variants + `cn` from @/lib/utils. Client components start with `'use client'`. Pages in app/(dashboard)/* are async server components that fetch via lib/services/* and pass plain (JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(...))) data to a *Client.tsx component. Forms use react-hook-form + zodResolver + a zod schema in lib/validators/*. Toggles today are hand-rolled: a `<button>` with a `rounded-full` track + an absolutely-positioned `<span>` knob — these must be replaced by the new components/ui/toggle-switch.tsx. Color convention to ENFORCE: primary accent #007AFF blue everywhere (nav active, buttons, CTAs); green #34C759 only for paid/active status tints; warning #FF9500; destructive #FF3B30; text #1C1C1E / secondary #8E8E93 / border #E5E5EA / bg #F2F2F7 / card white.
directory_structure: components/ui/* = shadcn primitives; components/layout/* = Sidebar/TopBar/BottomNav; components/auth/LoginForm.tsx; components/{rooms,plans,residents,settings}/*Client/Form.tsx = feature UI; app/(auth)/login + app/(dashboard)/* = App Router pages (server components fetch data, render a *Client.tsx); lib/utils.ts = cn(); lib/validators/* = zod schemas; lib/services/* = business logic (untouched); models/* = Mongoose schemas (untouched).
